findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1029 checks terminal state only before the worker claim; after claiming, the worker performs one-shot reads and reaches runHostRun at line 1138 without another terminal, cancellation, or deadline fence, while reconciliation at line 1511 can publish timed_out when that worker is alive but providerIdentity is still null. A paused worker can therefore resume after the immutable terminal and spawn a provider execution the receipt does not cover. Add a shared launch-authority fence immediately before spawn and prevent terminalization until that fence proves the worker can no longer launch.

packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:737 performs an unlocked snapshot read-modify-write; heartbeat at line 1107 and passthrough at line 1205 can pass their terminal check and later overwrite the terminal snapshot written at line 825. Concurrent reconciliation can leave terminal.json paired with a stale running snapshot or generation, causing projectionFor to reject the binding instead of every caller converging on the terminal receipt. Serialize snapshot writers with terminal authority or use terminal-aware compare-and-swap semantics, with a cross-process race test.

packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:803 validates only that managed-review findings is an array, and packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1756 persists nested findings without runtime validation of severity, category, evidenceState, files, or unknown fields. The importer then signs those unchecked values at packages/main/src/handlers/managed-review-evidence.ts:254; unknown severity/evidenceState values become nonblocking. An executable probe confirmed that severity "urgent" and category "invented" are classified as valid. Apply one strict nested finding validator at envelope classification, proposal persistence, and import.

packages/main/src/cli/ownership-gate.ts:65 resolves Story ownership only from storyId/story, special autopilot run IDs, or the active Story, but host_run_status and host_run_cancel expose only runId and are classified as storyScopedMutating. Line 257 skips lease enforcement when no active Story exists, while a different active Story checks the wrong lease before the handlers reconcile or cancel the sealed run. Resolve managed runId to its immutable spec.storyId inside the shared ownership boundary and add cross-Story and root-cwd cancellation tests.

.lattice/story/actives/B-137a/plan.md:71 says native reviewer lanes retain their existing signed ReviewRun/pass/finding path, but packages/main/src/handlers/finding.ts:425 now unconditionally requires direct-review authority and packages/main/src/core/native-review-evidence.ts:165 rejects without a registered broker attestation. This diff contains no production broker registration or descriptor injector and lattice.config.json has no nativeReviewInvocation registration, so the generated native-review mode cannot record formal evidence. Ship and configure the broker boundary or preserve a functioning native path.

packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts:972 invokes runCodexReviewLeaf with usageLedger enabled, causing its preflight and unavailable-final records at packages/main/src/core/codex-review-leaf.ts:565 and line 653. The managed runner then invokes runHostRun with unredacted usageEnv at packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1161, causing a second preflight, budget decision, and final sequence beginning at packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:1652 for the same provider execution. This duplicates diagnostic rows and can apply budget admission twice; transfer one ledger correlation to ManagedHostRun or disable leaf accounting in managedExecution mode.

packages/main/src/handlers/story-dispatch.ts:177 tells the controller that the provider writes managed_review_proposal_set, while packages/main/src/core/managed-review-evidence.ts:133 explicitly forbids that command and docs/host-run-usage.md:184 describes it as compatibility-only. The generated execution guidance contradicts the implemented terminal-envelope protocol and can direct operators toward the wrong evidence path. State that the provider returns the bounded final envelope and the managed adapter seals it.

packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts:1011 preserves the detached temporary Git worktree, and line 1017 is the only cleanup path. If an operator never resumes the detached cross_host_review after terminal, cancellation, or expiry, ManagedHostRun retention removes only its runtime directory and never removes this full checkout or Git worktree metadata. Associate snapshot cleanup with terminal retention/reconciliation or register a bounded recovery cleanup path.
